description: Definition of "code layers". Every file can only import other files from layers *below its own layer*, which is why the entrypoint file ("src/index.ts") is in its own isolated layer at the very bottom.

maxSccFiles.description: Target amount of SCCs (strongly connected components). Should approach 0 via refactors, and then stay there.

enforceLayers.description: Whether to make the "pnpm check-deps" (and subsequently the "pnpm lint") script fail when the strict import layers were breached by a module in the codebase. This should realistically never be turned off, unless a major refactor is currently underway.

layers.description: The index inside this array dictates the layer number. Modules can only import other modules that are in *lower layers than themselves* (layers with a lower index / further up), which is why the entrypoint file ("src/index.ts") is in its own isolated layer at the very bottom.

items.description: Contains paths to all modules that are part of this layer. These items' ordering doesn't matter.
A relative module path, starting at the project root. Accepts simple ** and * glob patterns.
